I renewed my investigation this weekend, into whether there is an autonomous strategy that averages more than one million points per game. show_hn.title: Show HN: You Can Just Filter YouTube Playlists in the 'Save to Playlist' Dialog
show_hn.story_text: Hi HN, I'm Cody, I have 847 YouTube playlists, and always hated that YouTube failed to provide basic playlist management tools. Ctrl+F was never convenient and breaks past 200 playlists. So I built & shipped my first Chrome extension. It replaces the Save dialog with a native-feeling searchable one that fetches all your playlists (and whether the current video is saved there) directly from YouTube's InnerTube API. It works robustly across every current save surface (watch page, home feed, search results, Shorts via right-click or Alt+S). This version is faster and more stable than my original attempt. In 1.0 I read and wrote YouTube's DOM directly. It felt like the efficient approach, but makes for constant UI regressions as YouTube changes, so I can't recommend it.

Show HN: KronLSTM Walkthrough
show_hn.story_text: KronLSTM launched! KronLSTM is built on the Kronecker Delta Rule: instead of correcting the vector stored at a key, it corrects a single scalar, how strongly this key is bound to this value. An existing association is disturbed only if both its key AND its value overlap with the new pair (Klambauer). Enjoy a short walkthrough of the net.
